name: Decisions API
desc: A low-latency endpoint for picking one answer from a fixed set.
desc_zh: 一个低延迟接口，用来从固定选项里挑出一个答案。
solves: A full model call is slow and expensive when the answer is one of five labels. Decisions API keeps the cost down for classification, routing and next-step choices.
solves_zh: 答案只是五个标签之一时，调一次完整模型又慢又贵。Decisions API 把分类、路由和下一步选择这类调用的成本压下来。
best_for: Your app needs to classify, route or branch on every request.
best_for_zh: 你的应用要在每个请求上做分类、路由或分支判断。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI DevDay 2026 recap, https://openai.com/index/devday-2026-recap）。 Limited preview on 2026-09-29; general availability with GPT-6 Luna announced 2026-10-22. platform.openai.com/docs/guides/decisions redirects to developers.openai.com. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/decisions-api 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions）。
